name: Business Dual Credit (Richmond SD38 with KPU Melville School of Business)
org: Richmond School District 38 and Kwantlen Polytechnic University
what_you_do: Take four business courses that transfer to a university. They are marketing, talking at work, how groups work, and accounting. You go full time at KPU Surrey in semester 2.
who_can_apply: Students registered in a Richmond SD38 school. English 12 and Math 11 at 67% or higher, strong attendance.
pay_detail: District pays tuition. Books, supplies and travel are the student's cost.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027-28 are available. Due date not found on the page read. The page says applications are due the year before.
how_to_apply: Get the application form from the district page or the school Career Programs board.
notes: Earns 16 senior high school credits and 4 college courses. Confirm the due date with careerprograms@sd38.bc.ca.
